T13_uniform_source_analyticity_to_compos.statement: Let W_a(J)=log Z_a(J) be analytic for |z_i|<R_i after coupling finitely many smeared gauge-invariant sources J=sum_i z_i P_i(f_i). If |W_a(J)|<=M uniformly in regulator and volume on the source polydisc, then every connected n-point source derivative obeys a regulator/volume-uniform factorial bound.
T13_uniform_source_analyticity_to_compos.proof: Multivariable Cauchy integral formula on the source polydisc.

T14_anisotropy_from_insertion_bound.statement: For S_a(lambda)=S_a(0)+lambda a^alpha V_aniso and a normalized expectation <O>_lambda, if |Cov_lambda(O,V_aniso)|<=C_O uniformly for lambda in [0,1], then |<O>_1-<O>_0|<=C_O a^alpha.
T14_anisotropy_from_insertion_bound.proof: Differentiate: d/dlambda <O>_lambda=-a^alpha Cov_lambda(O,V_aniso), then integrate lambda from 0 to 1.

T15_finite_RG_crossing_from_inverse_coup.statement: If q_k=g_k^{-2} obeys q_{k+1}<=q_k-c with c>0 whenever g_k<g_star, then the trajectory reaches g_k>=g_star in at most ceil(max(0,(g_0^{-2}-g_star^{-2})/c)) RG steps.
T15_finite_RG_crossing_from_inverse_coup.proof: Induction gives q_k<=q_0-kc. Choose k so q_k<=g_star^{-2}.

T16_AF_remainder_OPE_summability.statement: Any source/OPE RG remainder bounded by C g_j^p in a scale-localized norm with p>2 is summable over an arbitrarily deep asymptotically-free UV tail under g_j^{-2}>=g_B^{-2}+2b0 log(L)j.
T16_AF_remainder_OPE_summability.proof: Same monotone integral comparison as the Balaban-AF bridge.
